risks.title: High leverage and refinancing risk
risks.score_rationale: The risk is listed first in the 10-K, with strong language ('substantial indebtedness') and exposure to refinancing and interest rate risk. The Capital category is highly weighted in case of cash flow difficulties. The risk is stable compared to the prior year.

risks.title: Commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions food cost volatility, particularly cheese, as a recurring and significant risk. The language highlights a direct impact on profitability. This risk is stable and central to the sector. The Industrial category is heavily impacted.

risks.title: Cyber threats and data breaches
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned with concerning language ('data breaches, power loss, technological failures'). It directly affects operational continuity and reputation. The rise in cyberattacks across the sector increases its intensity. Category is highly critical.

risks.title: Intense competition in markets
risks.score_rationale: The document describes the sector as 'intensely competitive' with threats from competitors and new technologies. The language is repeated and emphasizes impact on brand and demand. This risk is stable but structural.

risks.title: International operations risks
risks.score_rationale: International operations expose the company to foreign exchange, regulatory, and geopolitical risks. The text mentions country-specific differences and impact on revenues. A 10% depreciation scenario is quantified at $30M. Category is moderately weighted.

risks.title: Franchisee dependency
risks.score_rationale: 99% of global stores are operated by independent franchisees. Growth and revenues heavily depend on franchisee success. The text emphasizes the risk of local mismanagement affecting brand and royalties. Strong and repeated language. Industrial category is critical to the business model.

risks.title: Technology and AI evolution
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly cites AI, new technologies, and their impact on consumer behavior and competitive advantage. Language is forward-looking and concerning ('impact of new or improved technologies'). This risk is increasing in intensity with accelerating technological change. Technology category is highly weighted.

ai_positioning.summary: Domino's acknowledges the potential impact of new technologies and AI on consumer behavior and competitiveness. The company identifies risks related to technological change, including AI, as a growing threat requiring continuous adaptation.
evidence: 10-K Risk Factors: Impact of new or improved technologies, including AI, on consumer behavior and competitive advantage
